On receipt of the present Petition, the Bid Process Coordinator (hereinafter referred to as “the BPC”), PFC Consulting Limited (hereinafter referred to as “PFCCL”), vide letter dated 31.12.2025, was directed to submit the relevant documents regarding the complete process of competitive bidding. The necessary details have been filed by the BPC vide affidavit dated 15.1.2026. 3. On 21.0.2026, the Petition was admitted, and notice was issued to the Respondents to file their respective replies. During the hearing, in response to the specific query regarding the instant Petition being filed by AESL instead of KPS III HVDC Transmission Limited (hereinafter referred to as “KPSIIITL”), the representative of the Petitioner submitted that AESL is the successful bidder, who acquired the 100% shareholding of the SPV, i.e., KPSIIITL. He further submitted that, in view of the criticality of the Project and the strict timeline for filing these applications after signing 4. Vide Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) dated 21.1.2026, the Petitioner was directed to implead KPS III HVDC Transmission Limited as CoPetitioner and POWERGRID KPS3 Transmission Limited and South Olpad Transmission Limited as Respondents, and to file an amended memo of parties. The Petitioner was further directed to carry out necessary amendments in the instant Petition, if required, in terms of Regulation 37(2) of the Conduct of Business Regulations. In compliance with the RoP dated 21.1.2026, the Petitioner vide affidavit dated 2.2.2026 filed the revised memo of parties. 8. Vide RoP dated, 24.2.2026, the Petitioner was again directed to submit the amended memo of parties and the proof of service to the newly impleaded Respondents, along with a supporting affidavit. 9. In compliance with the RoP dated 24.2.2026, the Petitioner, vide affidavit dated 2.3.2026, placed on record the proof of service upon the newly impleaded Respondents, along with the revised Memo of Parties. 10. During the hearing, the representative of the Petitioners submitted that the amended memo of parties has already been filed vide affidavit dated 2.3.2026 and they have also complied with all the requirements, including publication of notices under the provisions of the Transmission Licence Regulations. After hearing the parties to the Petition, the matter was reserved for the Orders. 11. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner, BPC, and CTUIL and perused the documents available on record. Section 63 of the Act provides as under: (c) The BPC shall prepare the bid documents in accordance with the Guidelines and obtain approval of the Appropriate Government, or alternatively, the BPC can use the Standard Bid Documents notified by the Ministry of Power. Any material deviation from the Standard Bidding Documents shall be made only with the prior approval of the Appropriate Government. Intimation about initiation of the bidding process shall be sent by the BPC to the Appropriate Commission. (k) The BPC shall make the final result of evaluation of all bids public. The final TSA, along with the certification by the bid evaluation committee, shall be 13. Therefore, we have to examine whether the Guidelines issued by the Central Government have been followed in the present case in a transparent process of bidding. 17. The BPC started the process of selection of the successful bidder with the publication of a Global Invitation for Qualification for the selection of a developer on a BOOT basis for the Project. The notice of the RfP was published in National/ International newspapers on 26.7.2024, with the last date of submission of response to the RfP as 30.9.2024. Intimation regarding the initiation of the bid process was given to this Commission on 31.7.2024 in accordance with Clause 4.2 of the Guidelines dated 10.8.2021. 25. In accordance with the provisions of the bid documents and upon the issuance of LoI to the successful bidder (Adani Energy Solutions Limited) and acquisition of SPV (the Co-Petitioner) by the successful bidder, the Petitioner has prayed for the adoption of transmission charges for the Project, which has been discovered through the competitive bidding process. 26. In accordance with Clause 2.15.2 of RfP, the selected bidder shall, within ten days of the issue of the Letter of Intent, accomplish the following tasks: 27. The proviso to Clause 2.15.2 of the RfP provides that "if for any reason attributable to the BPC, the said activities are not completed by the Selected Bidder within the above period of ten (10) days as mentioned in this clause, such period of 10 days shall be extended, on a day to day basis till the end of the Bid validity period". As per the above provision, the selected bidder was required to complete all the activities, including the acquisition of the SPV, by 24.11.2025. Though LoI was issued on 14.11.2025, BPC, vide its letter dated 12.12.2025, in terms of Clauses 2.15.2 of RfP, extended the date up to 12.12.2025 for completion of all activities by the successful bidder. The selected bidder furnished the Contract Performance Guarantee in favour of the Nodal Agency (CTUIL) for an amount of Rs. 553.73 crore on 9.12.2025 and acquired a hundred per cent equity-holding in the applicant company on 12.12.2025 after execution of the Share Purchase Agreement. As per clause 2.15.4 of the RfP, TSP is required to apply to the Commission for the adoption of transmission charges _2.
